requirement: 21 - Config options

$usergroup_approval_mappings - This is based on the U permission so it restricts the users that can be managed to the subordinate groups only if your user group is an approving group. Any user groups that can manage users but don't have any user groups to manage would see everything (the same as not having U when being a parent).

This config also applies to the user search e.g. via Grant Edit or sharing a resource. With the config in place and E permission set, users will only be able to find members of the same group, their subordinate groups or their parent group.
